record_note: Retro-record created 2026-10-30 from disk evidence for a design corrected 2026-10-28. Fields marked not independently re-verified were not re-measured from disk; they are sourced from on-disk build code/documents as cited in gate_verification.

gate_verification.G1_dims: disk-verified 2026-10-30: each deliverable measured with PIL (1080x1350) and hashed (see files).
gate_verification.base_size: disk-verified: base slide file measured on disk (instagram-audit carousel slide-1.jpg, 1080x1350).
gate_verification.print_size: disk-verified: print file measured on disk.
gate_verification.rect1000: sourced from on-disk builder ~/workspace/shirt-quality-fix/batch1/build_batch.py JOBS table; identical values also printed in SHIRT-PHOTO-QUALITY-CORRECTION-2026-10-28.md. Not re-grounded.
gate_verification.rect_px: recomputed 2026-10-30 from rect1000 x measured base size using the builder's own formula int(r/1000*W).
gate_verification.G2_art_paste_pixel_exact: retro-recorded 2026-10-30 from disk evidence; not independently re-verified. Per build_batch.py the cover-fit art was pasted directly into rect_px, then a 0.18 fabric-shading blend was applied over the pasted region, so the saved front's print region intentionally differs from the raw art and paste exactness cannot be re-measured from the saved JPEG.
gate_verification.G3_blend_factor: sourced from build_batch.py (Image.blend(cr, blended, 0.18)); not re-measured from the saved images.
gate_verification.G4_detail_crop_no_resize: derived from on-disk sources: builder takes centre crop min(1080,pw) x min(1150,ph) and resizes only if the crop is not exactly 1080x1150; measured print height 3694 px > 1150, so the crop was exactly 1080x1150 and the resize branch was not taken.
gate_verification.G4_detail_pixel_exact: retro-recorded 2026-10-30 from disk evidence; not independently re-verified as bit-exact. The saved detail slide is a q95 JPEG, so bit-exactness against the PNG print file cannot hold on disk; supporting check 2026-10-30: mean abs pixel difference between the saved slide's crop region and the print file's centre crop = 0.414 (JPEG-level difference only).
